text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nnh~, my nose is so tickly...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... King-chan put some cream on my 
pimple, you see.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's all sticky, and the smell... kinda 
tickles my nose... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I hope this pimple clears up soon~.

It seemed Haru Urara was having trouble 
with her skin...
